objective: Attribute the cost, precision and reliability effects of retaining mechanism-set uncertainty in the existing general U/L/H workflow on common observed data and fixed source prefixes.
implementation_identity: current_method/atlas_new/workflow.py general smoothness/simplex certificate with computational min(Bbar,BLip); not the new linear-moment target-next-W theorem, not a legacy prototype.

calibrated_U.radii: joint-max calibrated radius for all 10 sources and the target

proxy_point.information_status: invalid zero-uncertainty negative control; no mechanism coverage claim

oracle_true_point.centers: true source and target locations, exposed only to this reference
oracle_true_point.information_status: additional-information oracle; not a practicable method

smoothness: Keep the exact original analytic L,H for each surface in all variants; no L,H or proxy-scale scan.
random_order_rule: default_rng(SeedSequence([profile seed,surface_id,scenario_id,replicate,20])).permutation(arange(4,10)); common to every variant and mode
selection_scope: No targeted bridge selection, no nearest schedule; at each stage refit weights on the identical source prefix.
optimizer: Reuse existing workflow.optimize unchanged; design-only multi-start SLSQP with uniform/vertices/own previous weights extended by zero; no global-optimum claim; no cross-variant or oracle-weight warm starts.

statistical_allocation.oracle_eta_handling: Keep identical multipliers and eta field; do not spend freed mechanism failure budget on narrower noise bounds.
statistical_allocation.coverage_scope: Per-policy finite-horizon path guarantee when applicable; not simultaneous across methods and not conditional on release.

same_weight_reference: calibrated_U actual saved optimized weights separately at every mode and stage; evaluate all three input variants at exactly those weights and identical source observations

execution_views.fixed_budget: Actually collect each common prefix through stage 3; all-target certificate estimates/intervals at budgets 0..3; no stopping and no tolerance duplication required.
execution_views.stopped: Separately execute first certificate radius <= tolerance or budget exhaustion; actual cost and output certificate/refusal envelope remain separate from fixed-budget output.
execution_views.acquisition: Historical and per-source trial streams are shared exactly across variants/modes; future outcomes never enter planning; stopped runs do not acquire unused later trials.
execution_views.refusal: Variant-specific design and distances; label as outer refusal envelope, not sharp PI. Empty/inconsistent is not zero-width success.

primary_metrics: certificate full width and change from stage 0
true-target absolute error and squared error
paired contrasts calibrated_U minus proxy_point and calibrated_U minus oracle_true_point
secondary_metrics: release and unconditional bad release at .2/.3
mechanism event and finite-horizon path coverage
conditional released error with zero-release values missing
aggregation: All 9 surface/scenario cells plus equal-surface pooling within each scenario; 200 independent worlds per cell; pair comparisons by world. Never count methods, budgets or tolerances as independent worlds.
inference_scope: Exploratory individual paired intervals, resampling worlds within surface/scenario; no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim; coverage failures/negative results retained.

before_review.scope: A frozen single-world trace can clarify inputs and radius terms; does not complete writing review.
All weights design-only; Rinf secondary is not evidence of outcome-adaptive selection utility.
Bind every result to general U/L/H implementation, variant and output object; no headline replacement before results.
Isolate mechanism-set uncertainty in a synthetic known-label model. Cannot provide real U or certify real L,H; keep status open.
No real-data certificate, no microcredit qualification change.
No Many Labs target-noise or cross-family analysis.
Matched component attribution with full fixed/stopped cost accounting; no ExAtlas, sample split or direct-trial superiority test.
Keep simplex; no justification against signed/alternative estimators.
Frozen random paths only; no target-next-W/logdet theorem validation or adaptive acquisition claim.
Explicit implementation and oracle/negative-control identities; no complete manuscript naming fix.
Separate certificate, refusal envelope, fixed budget, stopping, bad release and empty-region states.

interpretation_rules: A narrower proxy-point interval is not a gain unless reliability is separately reported; no guarantee is assigned to it.
Oracle is extra location information, not true-effect access or a practicable comparator.
All variants use unchanged known synthetic smoothness bounds and source-noise scales.
At calibrated weights, calibrated geometry >= proxy-point geometry always; calibrated geometry >= oracle geometry only on the joint mechanism-set coverage event.
Do not demand that proxy-point empirically undercover; conservative other terms can mask omission.
No reoptimized ordering is asserted from a local SLSQP solver; retain and inspect discrepancies without outcome-based retuning.
No simulated U result is real-world U calibration; no reviewer status automatically resolved.
required_checks: exactly shared calibration archive, source observations and random source prefix across variants/modes
true coordinates enter oracle design only; true effects enter scoring only
variant-specific refusal design, no accidental world.design fallback
reconstruct radius from components and weighted estimate from saved source effects
same-weight deterministic inequalities with event qualification
fixed-budget actual cost equals stage*96; stopped cost equals acquired observations*96
stopped outputs never consume future observations; carried rows marked
all finite/nonempty and inconsistent states retained; conditional zero-release metrics undefined
primary/scoring perturbation invariance of design-only plans and decisions
all 12 reviewer concerns checked before smoke, after smoke and after full

initial_runtime_estimate.resource: 4 CPU worker processes; SciPy SLSQP, not GPU
initial_runtime_estimate.basis: Same-machine round01-cost-precision smoke 27 worlds 8.483s/full1800 worlds429.622s; new24 optimize calls/world versus prior candidate enumeration. Historical ablations_full133.806s is supporting evidence from another environment.
initial_runtime_estimate.update_rule: Measure smoke, independent report review of its audit/schema, root communicates revised full estimate before full launch.

run_gates.smoke: Protocol committed first; root has already informed user of initial timing; relevant tests and smoke may then run.
run_gates.full: Smoke checks pass, report agent independently reviews, implementation sends revised runtime to root, and root confirms updated estimate has been communicated. No new user approval needed within authorized scope.
run_gates.writes: Fresh result directories only; preserve all original code/results; protocol changes after inspection require explicit versioned amendment, not overwrite.
